**Delay Repay compensates you when you arrive at your destination later than scheduled, regardless of the cause of the delay.** You don't need to prove the operator was at fault. Compensation is based on your **arrival delay** at your final destination, not the departure delay.

| 60 to 119 minutes | 100% of single fare paid |
| 120 minutes or more | 100% of total fare paid (including return leg) |

## Important Notes

- Claims must be submitted within **28 days** of the delayed journey
- Delay Repay applies to **all fare types**, including non-refundable Advance tickets
- If you had a missed connection as part of the same booking, the delay to your final arrival counts
